alerts.text: Language Barriers did not break after any recent patches, but received an update anyways to allow for customization of newer worlds: Innisgreen, Gibbi Point, and Ondarion.

Show Sim Info and Festive Milestones have minor, non-game breaking issues, but are otherwise functional and safe to use. View their pages for more information, and keep an eye on my website, Discord, and Bluesky for updates.
The rest of my mods are confirmed to be compatible with the most recent patch (February 19, 2026).
